brief:
Jerusalem's governor has warned that Israeli demolition operations and demolition notices targeting homes and facilities in Qalandiya, north of occupied Jerusalem, threaten Palestinian presence in the area and push residents toward forced displacement, according to Shehab Wire. The official characterized the campaign as a systematic effort to uproot communities from the territory.

The demolition notices and ongoing removal of structures have created an environment of uncertainty for residents of Qalandiya, a Palestinian area positioned in the northern part of Jerusalem. The governor's statement reflects mounting concerns among Palestinian officials over the cumulative effect of such operations on civilian populations and their ability to remain in their communities.
